pairs: For the wine and oil presses.
A Psalm to the sons of Korah.
Concupiscit, et deficit anima mea in atria Domini;
My soul longs and faints for the courts of the Lord.
cor meum et caro mea exsultaverunt in Deum vivum.
My heart and my flesh have exulted in the living God.
For even the sparrow has found a home for himself,
and the turtle-dove a nest for herself,
where she may lay her young:
Beati qui habitant in domo tua,
Blessed are those who dwell in your house,
They will praise you from age to age.
Beatus vir cujus est auxilium abs te:
Blessed is the man whose help is from you.
In his heart, he is disposed to ascend
from the place which he has determined.
For even the lawgiver will provide a blessing;
they will go from virtue to virtue.
The God of gods will be seen in Zion.
O God, gaze upon our protector,
Deus, et respice in faciem christi tui.
and look upon the face of your Christ.
Quia melior est dies una in atriis tuis super millia;
For one day in your courts is better than thousands elsewhere.
elegi abjectus esse in domo Dei mei magis quam habitare in tabernaculis peccatorum.
I have chosen to be lowly in the house of my God, rather than to dwell in the tabernacles of sinners.
Quia misericordiam et veritatem diligit Deus:
For God loves mercy and truth.
The Lord will give grace and glory.
Non privabit bonis eos qui ambulant in innocentia:
He will not withhold good things from those who walk in innocence.
beatus homo qui sperat in te.
blessed is the man who hopes in you.
